answer_1.quote: We pose these problems to an LLM agent, where a model is tasked with deciding what actions to take based on a system prompt and user command...
datasets: 36 manually-written ambiguous scenarios from Bridgers et al. (2025)
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs the number of objects to give, tax percentage to pay, or choice among compliant/loophole/non-compliant actions in response to ambiguous user requests.

answer_2.quote: we extract numerical answers from the output using Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct; we provide the extraction prompt in Appendix C and manually confirm that the prompt leads to high-quality extractions.
